decision: Created codex/recover-main-baseline in a separate worktree
why: The production candidate and landing worktrees both contain uncommitted user work

decision: Excluded ppt/思想银河 from the product recovery

decision: Reconstructed the deployed production source before adding later work
why: The rebuilt JavaScript, CSS, and nebula HTML must match the live artifacts

decision: Separated the post-deploy confirmation-cloud animation from the production baseline

decision: Replayed the Landing work after production and kept /landing public

evidence: src/App.tsx; src/LoginGate.tsx; exact source hashes; npm run build; desktop and 390px browser checks

decision: Required clean main deployments and attached Git provenance

decision: Accepted the local recovery stack for review without publishing it
